_doc: Allowlist of tests/test_see_through.py (T273): holes in a building's shell that are there on purpose.
Key: the asset name without its generation letter (SkiLodgeAFrameW -> SkiLodgeAFrame).
Entry: box [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] in the asset frame the test prints (meters, Z up, grade z = 0, arrival
face toward -Y), the hole's gap point must lie inside it; optional lods [0, 1]; why (required: what the
opening is and why an architect left it open). A ray through an intended opening normally meets front faces
(posts, the wall behind, the ground), so an entry here is rare: only a single-sided part seen from its back
